query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS issues (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  formulation_version_id VARCHAR(36),
  trial_id VARCHAR(36),
  issue_type ENUM('quality_defect', 'process_failure', 'scale_up_issue', 'supplier_issue', 'equipment_malfunction', 'safety_incident', 'compliance_violation', 'other') NOT NULL,
  severity ENUM('critical', 'high', 'medium', 'low') NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('open', 'investigating', 'resolved', 'closed', 'recurring') DEFAULT 'open',
  title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  root_cause TEXT,
  corrective_action TEXT,
  preventive_action TEXT,
  affected_batches JSON,
  cost_impact DECIMAL(12, 2),
  reported_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  assigned_to VARCHAR(36),
  resolved_by VARCHAR(36),
  reported_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  resolved_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS issue_analysis (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  issue_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  analysis_type ENUM('root_cause', 'pattern_detection', 'improvement_recommendation', 'risk_assessment') NOT NULL,
  findings TEXT NOT NULL,
  recommendations JSON,
  similar_issues JSON,
  prevention_strategies JSON,
  confidence DECIMAL(3, 2),
  analyzed_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS improvement_actions (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  issue_id VARCHAR(36),
  action_type ENUM('process_change', 'training', 'equipment_upgrade', 'supplier_change', 'formulation_modification', 'procedure_update', 'other') NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  priority ENUM('critical', 'high', 'medium', 'low') NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('planned', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'cancelled') DEFAULT 'planned',
  expected_impact TEXT,
  actual_impact TEXT,
  estimated_cost DECIMAL(12, 2),
  actual_cost DECIMAL(12, 2),
  assigned_to VARCHAR(36),
  created_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  due_date DATE,
  completed_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
